0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6, 3rd in the Southeast and 9th in the East, 2.5 games back in their division) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7, 5th in the Pacific and 14th in the West, 5.5 games back), with Miami 2-3 on the road and riding a one-game losing streak, while Sacramento is 0-3 at home and also on a one-game skid. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and no games have been played between the two teams yet this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Heat's most recent meeting was a 130-117 win in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
